title: Rescalings of weak blow-up limits are weak blow-up limits with rescaled weights (conditional on blowup_calculus and blowup_imrep)
statement: Assume (BC) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_calculus: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0: (i) M_W(blowUp T x λ) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·M_{(dilation x λ)⁻¹(W)}(T) for every W; (ii) currentEval (blowUp T x λ) ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P λ) (−(λ⁻¹•x)) ω) for every n-form ω on ℝ^P; (iii) currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x λ) y μ) ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + λ•y) (λμ)) ω for all y ∈ ℝ^P, μ > 0 and n-forms ω. Assume also (BUI) — the frozen type of the selected node's registered dependency blowup_imrep (the reused accepted rep_pushforward): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0 and every IMRep R of T in U there is an IMRep R′ in dilation x λ '' U representing blowUp T x λ with R′.measure(s) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·R.measure((dilation x λ)⁻¹(s)) for every Borel s. Then for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), all points c_i ∈ ℝ^P and scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ), every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly), every y ∈ ℝ^P and every λ > 0 there is S′ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that blowUp T (c_i + t_i•y) (t_iλ) ⇀ S′ in ℝ^P, and for every IMRep R of S in ℝ^P there is an IMRep R′ of S′ in ℝ^P with R′.measure = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ) • R.measure.map (dilation y λ).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn (dilation x lam ⁻¹' W)) ∧ (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) ω)) ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 < mu) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') y mu hmu.ne') ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + lam • y) (lam * mu) (mul_pos hlam hmu).ne') ω) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S → ∃ S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i + ts i • y) (ts i * lam) (mul_pos (hts i) hlam).ne') S' ∧ ∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents S → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents S' ∧ R'.measure = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation y lam)
